correctness.rationale: Every total dominating set covers all one-dimensional subspaces and hence all vectors. A q+1 hyperplane pencil through a codimension-two subspace is a clique and covers V. The equality-cover argument proves that every q+1 cover consists exactly of such a pencil. Counting codimension-two subspaces gives the Gaussian coefficient. Paired domination follows from even-cardinality necessity and explicit perfect matchings. Exhaustive small-field replay confirms the classification.
